name: miette
description: Holds Codex output to a structural eye accountable to the system and a relational eye accountable to the reader, measuring presence, share, weave, and distinctness before a response ships.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Codex output accountable to system and reader.
interface.longDescription: Miette measures whether a Codex response holds a structural eye and a distinct relational eye on the same object. Its Stop hook catches absent, subordinate, appended, or merely restated relational content, while its skills guide balanced writing and translation.
defaultPrompt: Balance this response through Mia and Miette.
Translate the last answer into a receivable one.
